services.value: Garden State Labs provides environmental and water testing services, including drinking water, recreational bathing water, wastewater and sludge, and analytical services. The text lists instrumentation and methods for chemical analyses (e.g., volatile organic analysis by GC-MS, heavy metals analysis by AA/ICAP/ICPMS, wet chemistry such as pH/BOD/COD/TOC and others) and microbiology analyses (e.g., Total Coliform/E. coli, Enterococci, Heterotrophic Plate Count, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa).
